prompt_set:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CH01 E-facing four-pose game animation source atlas, requested native 2048 x 2048 transparent PNG.
Reference image fixes the character identity, costume, giant axe and hand-painted material detail. Draw FOUR complete isolated figures in an exact 2 x 2 layout, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. All face EAST, screen-right, from a high three-quarter near-isometric camera. True sideward facing anatomy, not southeast or frontal.
Character: handsome adult male, short tousled brown hair, athletic muscular torso; deep navy #233b66 fitted split coat, sculpted silver #e0e6ef armor with fine gold fittings, vermilion #d6554e scarf, dark trousers and silver armored boots. One huge cool golden-silver crescent greataxe with dark volcanic inner plates, restrained orange rune cracks, sunstone center and integral jagged rock shapes. Same character and weapon design in all four.
Frames: 0 top-left combat-ready idle, axe held beside waist; 1 top-right walking right with LEFT leg forward; 2 bottom-left walking right with RIGHT leg forward, opposite stride and arm weight; 3 bottom-right basic attack wind-up, torso twisted back, elbows bent, axe drawn compactly behind shoulder ready for rightward heavy slash. Distinct poses, same true EAST-facing camera.
Bright warm-sunlit hand-painted cartoon fantasy, painted 2.5D volume, clean sharp materials and readable silhouettes. Fixed anatomy scale: each head-top to average sole ground about 450–550 actual source pixels if canvas is 1254; body width 250–400, total silhouette with axe under 550 wide. Keep overhead axe compact so hands, blade, scarf and both boots remain fully inside its quadrant, centered with at least 35 pixels clear transparent margin on EVERY quadrant edge. Four disconnected alpha islands, never touching center dividers. No ground, floor, cast shadow, effects, weapon trails, particles, detached floating fragments, borders, labels, text, watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep the four-pose EAST-facing axe warrior sheet's excellent hand-painted design, same outfit, same face, same genuine screen-right camera, same full character detail. Make ONLY these layout and walk-cycle corrections.
The canvas must remain transparent 2x2 with four complete isolated figures. Each quadrant needs 35px truly transparent margin at all four edges including central dividers. Shorten the flowing scarf tails and hold the giant crescent axe closer to the torso: complete blade and connected hands, no axe pixel crossing the x=627 or y=627 dividers. Do not crop anything. Keep anatomic head-top-to-average-sole height 450–550 actual pixels and fully visible boots.
Correct the walk frames to a visibly alternating walk: TOP RIGHT has nearer leg stepping forward to screen-right, far leg planted behind. BOTTOM LEFT has FAR leg stepping forward to screen-right and nearer leg trailing visibly bent back with heel lifted. Thus the silhouetted forward boot switches between near and far leg, and shoulders have opposing weight shift. This is consecutive opposite steps, not two copies of the same stance. Frame0 combat ready; frame3 compact backswing with a rightward target. Same EAST facing for all. No text, floor, shadows, trails, particles, watermark or extra figures.
